_doc: Repair spec for the workflow_chains table (backend/database/galaxy_ai_tools.db). Applied by backend/scripts/repair_workflow_chains.py. Plan: docs/20261101_CHAIN_FIX_PLAN.md (W2). A connection is only changed when the downstream workflow's own code declares the target parameter AND consumes the kind of artifact the upstream step publishes. Everything else is listed under needs_human_decision / unresolved with evidence, and is NOT patched. Keys other than connections/steps are informational and ignored by the script.

needs_human_decision.evidence: predict_admet_properties/main.nf declares params.smiles_list, but it must be an inline JSON array (workflow body: JsonSlurper().parseText(params.smiles_list) / PARAM_SMILES_LIST json.loads). The chain executor injects a FILE path/URI (artifact_value) and pharmacophore_filtering publishes filtered_compounds.smi. Renaming to smiles_list would pass a name check but crash at JsonSlurper. Needs a file->JSON-array adapter or a file-accepting param.

docking_autodock_vina/main.nf declares no ligand-file parameter (ligand input is params.smiles_list, inline JSON array, plus reference_ligand_smiles). predict_admet_properties publishes predict_admet_properties_results.json / toxicity_report.json / pk_summary.json / qc_metrics.json, no compound list or SDF named passed_compounds.

docking_autodock_vina declares params.box_center (and box_size) as inline JSON '[x,y,z]' (auto_convert json.loads). pocket_detection_druggability publishes <id>_pockets.json (a pockets report), <id>_top_pocket.pdb and a druggability TSV; the file path cannot be parsed as '[x,y,z]'. Needs an adapter that extracts the top-pocket centre.

gromacs_protein_md/main.nf declares params.ligand = 'ligand.sdf or ligand.mol2' (LIGAND_PREP accepts smi/sdf/sd/mol2/mol only; else 'unsupported ligand format'). docking_autodock_vina publishes docking_poses/*.pdbqt. Format mismatch (pdbqt not accepted); gromacs also needs params.receptor.

reinvent4_lead_design declares params.seed_smiles, a SMILES string (default coumarin SMILES, used as .replace("'", ...) text). gromacs_protein_md publishes mmgbsa/mmgbsa_results.csv and binding_summary.json (energies, no structures); a scores file is not a seed SMILES. Needs a decision on which compounds seed the design (e.g. top-ranked ligand SMILES).

drug_discovery_admet_gated_screening._note: Re-pointed 2026-11-01 (workstream B2, docs/20261101_VINA_SCREENING_CHAIN_BENCH_SCENARIO.md). User decision: docking uses docking_autodock_vina; structure_prediction_docking (id 10644, executable=0) is retired. Paths below are under backend/biomni_workflows/nextflow_nfcore/subworkflows/.

steps.evidence: workflows id 12824 = pharmacology/docking_autodock_vina/main.nf (executable=1). The old params_template key docking_engine is not declared by docking_autodock_vina (declared: smiles_list, receptor_pdb_file, box_center, box_size, ncpu, exhaustiveness, n_poses, reference_ligand_smiles, main.nf:8-15) and is dropped.

evidence: step1 filtered_smiles -> step2 smiles  =>  step1 filtered_compounds.smi -> step2 smiles_list [smiles_file_to_json_list]. upstream drug_discovery/pharmacophore_filtering/main.nf publishes filtered_compounds.smi (emit filtered_smiles, main.nf:388; written main.nf:407-409 as '<smiles>  <compound_id>' per line). Downstream predict_admet_properties declares smiles_list as an INLINE JSON array (pharmacology/predict_admet_properties/main.nf:21,844-845 (JsonSlurper) and PARAM_SMILES_LIST json.loads :48). The executor would inject a file path, so the connection carries the registered transform smiles_file_to_json_list (first whitespace token of each line).

step2 passed_compounds -> step3 ligand_sdf  =>  REMOVED and replaced by step1 filtered_compounds.smi -> step3 smiles_list [smiles_file_to_json_list]. predict_admet_properties publishes only predict_admet_properties_results.json, predict_admet_properties_output.txt, toxicity_report.json, pk_summary.json, qc_metrics.json (main.nf:108-112): no compound list and no SDF named passed_compounds. docking_autodock_vina declares no ligand_sdf; its ligand input is smiles_list (inline JSON array, pharmacology/docking_autodock_vina/main.nf:8,41,84). The only established source of the compound list is the pharmacophore step. upstream drug_discovery/pharmacophore_filtering/main.nf publishes filtered_compounds.smi (emit filtered_smiles, main.nf:388; written main.nf:407-409 as '<smiles>  <compound_id>' per line). Downstream docking_autodock_vina declares smiles_list as an INLINE JSON array (pharmacology/docking_autodock_vina/main.nf:8). The executor would inject a file path, so the connection carries the registered transform smiles_file_to_json_list (first whitespace token of each line).

needs_human_decision.evidence: The chain description says only ADMET-passing compounds advance to docking. predict_admet_properties publishes per-compound results/toxicity JSON but no filtered list (main.nf:108-112), so docking receives the PHARMACOPHORE-filtered list, not an ADMET-filtered one. Making ADMET a real gate needs a new transform (ADMET results JSON + thresholds -> SMILES list); not invented here.

step3 docking_autodock_vina: receptor_pdb_file (default '' -> status not_computed; a bare 4-char PDB ID is fetched from RCSB, pharmacology/docking_autodock_vina/main.nf:105-108)
box_center and box_size (defaults [0,0,0] / [20,20,20] are not a binding site; no pocket-detection step in this chain, so the user must supply them)

drug_discovery_screening._note: Re-pointed 2026-11-01 (workstream B2). Step 2 pinned to docking_autodock_vina (id 12824). Paths under backend/biomni_workflows/nextflow_nfcore/subworkflows/.

steps.evidence: workflows id 12824 = pharmacology/docking_autodock_vina/main.nf (executable=1); params_template was {} so nothing to drop.

evidence: step1 filtered_compounds -> step2 compounds  =>  REMOVED. Step 1 is predict_admet_properties, which publishes no 'filtered_compounds' (outputs: predict_admet_properties_results.json, _output.txt, toxicity_report.json, pk_summary.json, qc_metrics.json, pharmacology/predict_admet_properties/main.nf:108-112). docking_autodock_vina declares no 'compounds' param; its ligands come from smiles_list (inline JSON array). No upstream file can feed it, so the user supplies the same smiles_list to both steps.

step2 docked_poses -> step3 complexes  =>  REMOVED. predict_binding_affinity_protein_1d_sequence declares only smiles_list, amino_acid_sequence, affinity_model_type, outdir (pharmacology/predict_binding_affinity_protein_1d_sequence/main.nf:12-16); no param accepts a complex/pose file. docking publishes docking_poses/*.pdbqt (emit poses, pharmacology/docking_autodock_vina/main.nf:35), docking_autodock_vina_results.json (:32).

needs_human_decision.evidence: predict_binding_affinity_protein_1d_sequence needs smiles_list + amino_acid_sequence. Candidate: docking_autodock_vina_results.json (results[].smiles with best_affinity_kcal_mol, pharmacology/docking_autodock_vina/main.nf:368-372) -> smiles_list would need a new transform (docking results JSON -> top-N SMILES list); not registered, so left out. amino_acid_sequence (target sequence) must be supplied by the user.

With no connections the executor falls back to the extension heuristic (_EXT_TO_PARAM, connection-less chains only), which can only fill params named in the downstream workflow's declared inputs; for docking none of its heuristic names (compounds/ligand_sdf/input) are declared, so nothing is injected. Decide whether the chain should stay as a 3-step parameter-sharing bundle or be redefined.
ADMET (step 1) and docking (step 2) both need the same smiles_list; there is no established artifact between them.

connections.evidence: downstream nfcore/differentialabundance/main.nf declares params.matrix ('Count matrix CSV (genes x samples)', read into count_mat in DESEQ2_DIFFERENTIAL_ANALYSIS); it declares no 'counts'. upstream nfcore/rnaseq/main.nf SALMON_QUANT emits path counts_matrix.tsv. CAVEAT: differentialabundance selects the matrix with list.files(pattern='.csv') + read.csv, so a .tsv counts_matrix.tsv will not be picked up unless converted; parameter choice is right, file format is a separate defect.

needs_human_decision.evidence: gene_set_enrichment_analysis/main.nf declares genes (inline JSON list of symbols, auto_convert json.loads), background_list, database, top_k, plot; no 'input'. differentialabundance publishes *_DESeq2_results.csv tables; a results table is not a gene-symbol list. Needs an adapter (significant genes -> JSON list). Also note params_template key 'databases' is not declared (workflow declares 'database').

connections.evidence: downstream vep_annotation/main.nf declares params.input ('VCF or VCF.GZ file to annotate', used by Channel.fromPath(params.input)); it declares no 'vcf'. upstream nfcore/sarek publishes VCFs (germline calling).

downstream rare_disease/case_report_aggregation/main.nf declares params.vcf ('Annotated VCF from VEP step', Channel.fromPath(params.vcf)); upstream vep_annotation publishes <id>.vep.vcf.gz (emit vcf).

downstream case_report_aggregation declares params.drop_results ('DROP results directory or TSV', Channel.fromPath); upstream nfcore/drop runs OUTRIDER (aberrant expression). NOTE: DROP's stub main.nf declares no publishDir/emit, so the published filenames are unverified.

same param as above: case_report_aggregation has a single DROP input (drop_results); FRASER output is part of the same DROP results. NOTE: both connections target drop_results; _apply_connection_handoffs wires only the first (later ones skipped when key already set), so one DROP results artifact is passed.

needs_human_decision.evidence: nfcore/drop/main.nf declares params.input = 'Sample annotation TSV with sample, RNA_BAM_FILE, DROP_GROUP'; no BAM param exists. A BAM path is not a sample annotation table; needs an adapter that builds the annotation TSV from the rnaseq BAMs.

missing_required_params.note: case_report_aggregation also declares rnaseq_counts (optional) that nf-core/rnaseq could feed; the chain has no such connection and none is added here.

needs_human_decision.evidence: bioconductor/clusterprofiler/main.nf declares params.gene_list = 'path to gene_list.txt (one gene per line)' and reads only *.txt (readLines). bioconductor/deseq2/main.nf publishes condition_treated_results.csv, *.rds, qc_metrics.json (and has no standalone entry workflow or input params: only take: ch_input). A DE results CSV is not a gene list; needs an adapter (significant genes -> .txt).

bioconductor/enrichplot/main.nf declares only params.outdir and has no standalone entry workflow (only take: ch_input; reads staged input.csv). No parameter can receive an artifact. clusterprofiler publishes enrichGO_results_*.csv and ego_object.rds. NEEDS A NEW WORKFLOW (or an entry workflow with an input param) for step 3; step 1 (deseq2) also lacks a standalone entry.

step1 BIOC_DESEQ2: count matrix + coldata (staged input files; no params declared)
